headline: Modella Capital prepares auction for UK retailer TG Jones
summary: Modella Capital is planning a sale of high street retail chain TG Jones, formerly WH Smith, next year. The business currently employs about 3,500 people following the closure of 130 stores.
why: Modella Capital is a private equity turnaround investor that acquired the UK high street retail operation in 2025.

impacts.name: TG Jones
impacts.why: Ownership auction determines capital structure and operational future of the retail chain.
